-- REQ: LANG-661 LANG-662 LANG-663 LANG-664 library ieee; use ieee.std_logic_1164.all; use ieee.numeric_std.all; entity counter is generic (WIDTH : natural := 8); port ( clk : in std_logic; rst : in std_logic; count : out unsigned(WIDTH - 1 downto 0) ); end entity counter; architecture rtl of counter is signal value : unsigned(WIDTH - 1 downto 0) := (others => '0'); begin process (clk) begin if rising_edge(clk) and clk'event then if rst = '1' then value <= (others => '0'); else value <= value + 1; end if; end if; end process; count <= value; report "done ""quoted""" severity NOTE; assert x"FF" /= b"0000_0001"; END ARCHITECTURE rtl;
